business_name: Youngstown HVAC Services: Heating & Air Conditioning
audit_headline: The profile lists 'General Contractor' as the primary category instead of an HVAC-specific category, which directly undermines visibility when homeowners search for heating and air conditioning services in Youngstown.
summary: This business has a strong 4.9-star rating from 9 reviews and complete hours listed, but three critical gaps limit its local search performance. The primary category is set to 'General Contractor' rather than an HVAC trade category, no website is linked to the profile, and the profile has zero photos visible. Recent reviews from 11 months ago mention responsiveness, professionalism, and scheduling flexibility, but review volume and recency have stalled.

sections.title: Google Business Profile
sections.summary: The profile has complete hours and a listed phone number, but the primary category and lack of photos severely limit discoverability for HVAC searches.

findings.observation: The primary category is set to 'General Contractor' instead of an HVAC-specific category like 'HVAC Contractor' or 'Heating Contractor.' The business name clearly indicates heating and air conditioning services, but Google uses the primary category as the strongest relevance signal for matching searches to businesses.
findings.recommendation: Change the primary category to 'HVAC Contractor' in the Google Business Profile settings. This is the single most important fix for appearing in HVAC-related searches in Youngstown.

findings.observation: The profile shows 0 visible photos. Photos are a core trust and engagement signal; profiles with photos receive significantly more clicks and direction requests than those without.
findings.recommendation: Upload at least 10-15 photos showing your team, trucks with branding, completed HVAC installations, before-and-after work, and your service area. Prioritize exterior shots of your location and branded vehicles.

findings.observation: No website is linked on the profile. A website link provides a critical path for customers to learn more, see services, and contact you beyond the phone number.
findings.recommendation: Add a website to the profile. If you don't have one, create a simple one-page site with your services, service area, contact info, and hours, or use a free Google Site as an interim step.

findings.observation: Hours are listed and complete for all seven days (7 AM–8 PM weekdays, 9:30 AM–7 PM weekends), and a phone number (330) 227-1434 is present.

sections.title: Reviews & Reputation
sections.summary: The 4.9-star rating from 9 reviews is excellent, but review volume is low and the most recent reviews are 11 months old, signaling stalled momentum.

findings.observation: The business has 9 total reviews with a 4.9-star rating. While the rating is strong, 9 reviews is a low total for an HVAC business, and low review counts can reduce trust and click-through compared to competitors with dozens or hundreds of reviews.
findings.recommendation: Implement a consistent process to request reviews from satisfied customers immediately after service completion. Aim to build toward 25-50 reviews within the next 6-12 months.

findings.observation: The most recent review visible is from 11 months ago. Three of the five recent reviews are from that same timeframe, and one is from 6 years ago. Recency matters; fresh reviews signal an active, reliable business.
findings.recommendation: Restart your review-request process now. Send a follow-up text or email with a direct Google review link after every completed job.

findings.observation: Themes in the recent review text include responsiveness and speed ('urgent heating problem,' 'swiftly fixed,' 'record time'), professionalism and knowledge ('knowledgeable,' 'professional'), and scheduling flexibility ('accommodating to our schedule,' 'worked around our busy lives').
The Google Places API does not reveal whether you have responded to reviews. Responding to reviews—especially detailed ones—demonstrates engagement and can improve conversion.
findings.recommendation: Log into your Google Business Profile and verify that you have responded to all reviews, particularly the detailed 5-star ones. If you haven't, reply with a brief thank-you that mentions the specific service (e.g., 'Thanks for trusting us with your heating repair').

sections.title: Website & Online Presence
sections.summary: No website is linked on the profile, which eliminates a major trust and conversion channel.

findings.observation: No website is linked on the Google Business Profile. This means potential customers have no way to learn about your services, see pricing or service-area details, read FAQs, or contact you outside of calling. A website is a baseline expectation for service businesses in 2025.
findings.recommendation: Create and link a website. At minimum, include: your services (heating repair, AC installation, maintenance, etc.), service area (Youngstown and surrounding cities), contact info with click-to-call phone link, hours, and a few photos. Use a simple platform like Wix, Squarespace, or WordPress, or hire a local web designer.

findings.observation: Because no website is linked, this audit could not verify HTTPS, mobile-friendliness, local SEO signals (city + trade in the page title), click-to-call links, or structured data. These are all standard trust and ranking factors.
findings.recommendation: Once you have a website, ensure the homepage title tag includes 'HVAC' or 'Heating & Air Conditioning' and 'Youngstown, OH,' that the site uses HTTPS, that it is mobile-responsive, and that your phone number is a clickable tel: link.

sections.title: Missed Calls & Lead Capture
sections.summary: HVAC calls are often urgent and time-sensitive; any missed call is likely a lost job to a competitor who answers.

findings.observation: Your phone number (330) 227-1434 is listed on the profile, but this audit cannot measure your answer rate or after-hours handling. In the HVAC trade, many calls come during evenings or weekends when a furnace fails or an AC stops working. If those calls go to voicemail without a fast callback, the customer will call the next company.
findings.recommendation: Call your own number after hours and on weekends to confirm what callers hear. If you use voicemail, ensure the greeting states your callback time (e.g., 'within 30 minutes') and consider adding an after-hours answering service or automated text-back system that acknowledges the call immediately.

findings.observation: With no website linked, there is no online contact form, chat, or alternative lead-capture path. Every lead depends on the phone being answered or a voicemail being returned quickly.
findings.recommendation: Once you add a website, include a contact form and prominently display your phone number on every page. Consider adding a 'Text Us' option or a simple chatbot for after-hours inquiries.

findings.observation: Your hours show availability until 8 PM on weekdays and 7 PM on weekends, which is strong for capturing evening calls. Ensure your phone system or team can actually handle calls during those posted hours.
findings.recommendation: Verify that someone is available to answer or promptly return calls during all posted business hours. If you cannot staff the phone until 8 PM, adjust your listed hours to match reality.

fix_list.action: Change the primary category from 'General Contractor' to 'HVAC Contractor'
fix_list.rationale: The primary category is the strongest relevance signal Google uses to match your business to searches. Right now, you are categorized as a general contractor, not an HVAC specialist, which means you will not appear for 'HVAC repair Youngstown' or 'furnace repair near me' searches. This is the highest-impact fix.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile -> Edit profile -> Business category -> Select 'HVAC Contractor' as primary

fix_list.action: Upload 10-15 photos to the Google Business Profile
fix_list.rationale: Your profile currently shows 0 visible photos. Photos are a core trust signal and directly increase engagement (clicks, calls, direction requests). Include team photos, branded trucks, completed HVAC work, and your storefront or service area.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile -> Add photos -> Upload images

fix_list.action: Create and link a website to the Google Business Profile
fix_list.rationale: No website is linked, which eliminates a major trust and conversion path. Potential customers cannot learn about your services, see your service area, or contact you beyond calling. A simple one-page site with services, contact info, and hours is sufficient to start.
fix_list.where: Create a site on Wix, Squarespace, WordPress, or Google Sites, then add the URL in Google Business Profile -> Edit profile -> Website

fix_list.action: Request reviews from recent customers to build toward 25+ total reviews
fix_list.rationale: You have 9 reviews, which is low for an HVAC business. The most recent review is 11 months old, signaling stalled momentum. Fresh, frequent reviews improve trust, click-through, and local search visibility.
fix_list.where: Send a text or email with your Google review link after every completed job. Find your review link in Google Business Profile -> Get more reviews

fix_list.action: Verify you have responded to all existing reviews, especially the detailed ones
fix_list.rationale: The API does not show whether you respond to reviews. Responding demonstrates engagement and can improve conversion. Three of your recent reviews are detailed and mention specific service qualities.
fix_list.where: Google Business Profile -> Reviews -> Reply to each review with a brief, specific thank-you

fix_list.action: Call your own number after hours to test your voicemail and callback process
fix_list.rationale: HVAC calls are often urgent. If after-hours calls go to a generic voicemail or are not returned quickly, you lose jobs to competitors. Your hours show availability until 8 PM, but this audit cannot verify your answer rate.
fix_list.where: Call (330) 227-1434 after 8 PM and on Sunday evening. Listen to the greeting and time how long it takes to get a callback.

fix_list.action: Once the website is live, ensure the homepage title includes 'HVAC' or 'Heating & Air Conditioning' and 'Youngstown, OH'
fix_list.rationale: The page title is a core local SEO signal. Including your trade and city helps Google understand what you do and where you serve, improving visibility for local searches.
fix_list.where: In your website builder, edit the homepage settings and set the page title to something like 'Youngstown HVAC Services | Heating & Air Conditioning Repair in Youngstown, OH'

fix_list.action: Add a contact form and click-to-call phone link to the website
fix_list.rationale: With no website currently linked, you have no alternative lead-capture path beyond the phone. A contact form and clickable phone number (especially on mobile) provide additional conversion paths and capture leads when you cannot answer the phone.
fix_list.where: In your website builder, add a contact form block and format your phone number as (330) 227-1434 in the HTML or use the builder's phone link feature

not_checked: Whether you have responded to your 9 existing reviews — the API does not reveal this. Log into your Google Business Profile and check the Reviews section to verify.
Your actual call answer rate and after-hours handling — call your own number (330) 227-1434 after 8 PM and on weekends to hear what customers experience.
Whether you have claimed and optimized other local directory listings (Yelp, Angi, HomeAdvisor, BBB) — this audit only examined your Google presence.
Your competitors' profiles, review counts, and category choices in Youngstown — search 'HVAC repair Youngstown' on Google Maps to see who appears and compare their profiles to yours.
Whether your business name, address, and phone number are consistent across the web (NAP consistency) — use a tool like Moz Local Check or manually search your business name to verify.
closing_note: The category fix, photo uploads, and website addition are all within your control and can be completed in a few hours of focused work. These are recognized local-search best practices that address the most significant gaps in your current profile. Pair them with a consistent review-request process, and you will have a much stronger foundation for competing in Youngstown HVAC searches.
